result.topic_en: Statement of Problem VI on the vibrations of an elastic lamina free at both ends A and B but fixed by a pin at an intermediate point C, with preliminary remarks on the continuity at C and the start of the equation for the portion EC.
result.transcription:
LAMINARVM ELASTICARVM. 483
Problema VI.
Si lamina vtroque termino A et B fuerit libera sed circa medium alicubi in C ſtylo defixa, motus vibratorios definire, quos recipere poteſt.
Solutio.
Antequam ſolutionem huius problematis ſuſcipiamus, ſequentia praenotari oportet: 1°. in ipſo puncto C vbi applicata perpetuo euaneſcere debet, euidens eſt vtrinque angulos A C E et B C F aequales eſſe debere propterea quod lamina nusquam inflexionem ad angulum finitum admittit, quum ergo hi duo anguli ſimul euaneſcant et ſimul maxime ab axe declinent perſpicuum eſt, ambas portiones C E et C F paribus temporibus oſcillationes ſuas eſſe abſoluturas, interim tamen ſtylus in C defixus neceſſario ſaltum in lege continuitatis producere debet, quum portio C F certe alium motum ſit receptura, quam ſi ſtylus abeſſet, tempore tamen vibrationis eodem manente, ita vt pro vtraque portione littera noſtra $\theta$, eundem habeat valorem. His igitur notatis, ponamus portionem $AC=\alpha$ et alteram $BC=\beta$, ita vt $\alpha+\beta$ aequetur toti longitudini $a$ vocetur pro priori parte $AX=x$ et $XY=y$, pro altera vero parte $Bx'=x'$ et $Y'x'=y'$, et ſtatuentur aequationes ponendo breuitatis gratia $\frac{\theta x}{b}=\Phi$ et $\frac{\theta x'}{b}=\Phi'$.
Pro portione E C
$y=\cos.\theta\theta t(A\cos.\Phi+B\sin.\Phi+Ce^{\Phi}+De^{-\Phi}$
Ppp 2 Pro

items.quote: Si lamina vtroque termino A et B fuerit libera sed circa medium alicubi in C ſtylo defixa, motus vibratorios definire, quos recipere poteſt.
items.english: If a lamina is free at both ends A and B but fixed by a pin somewhere about the middle at C, to determine the vibratory motions which it can receive.

items.quote: ambas portiones C E et C F paribus temporibus oſcillationes ſuas eſſe abſoluturas
items.english: Both portions CE and CF will complete their oscillations in equal times.

items.quote: ita vt pro vtraque portione littera noſtra $\theta$, eundem habeat valorem
items.english: So that for both portions our letter θ has the same value.
